entries.title: v4-043 mechanical exemptions: 20 FastAPI handlers (health/splash/proxy/debug/security primitives)
entries.risk: Low. The 20 exempted handlers carry no business logic that v4-043 is meant to gate (health checks, static splash pages, transfer/proxy redirects, debug endpoints, mTLS/session/Key Vault security primitives). Exemption is mechanical, not a waiver of any underlying control. Real v4-043 enforcement remains active for all business-logic handlers (currently /classify, score_provider, score_trial, explain, evaluate_providers, evaluate_view — tracked by BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-001). Residual risk: future edits to an exempted handler could quietly add business logic without graph routing; mitigated by re-review under BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-EXEMPT-001 when the broader graph refactor is scheduled.
entries.mitigation: Each exempted handler carries an inline `# graph-exempt: <reason>; per BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-EXEMPT-001` comment so the scanner exemption-window catches it and the rationale is visible at the call site. BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-EXEMPT-001 (deferred) tracks revisiting every exemption when the graph-orchestration refactor is scheduled. Real business-logic v4-043 violations remain blocking under BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-001.
entries.description: Per human directive 2026-04-19 — fix mechanical v4-043 violations to clear pre-push, leave business-logic refactors as separate work. Scope: 20 FastAPI route handlers across Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py, Code/evaluate_care/app.py, and Code/shared_services/app.py. Expires 2026-12-31 (revisit during scheduled graph-orchestration refactor). Exempted handlers: (1) Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py: health, get_session, evaluate_splash, transfer_to_findcare, evaluate_proxy, shared_splash, shared_verify_token, evaluate_verify_token, serve_index. (2) Code/evaluate_care/app.py: debug_verify_live, debug_bootstrap, health, splash, transfer_to_findcare, verify_token. (3) Code/shared_services/app.py: health, splash, transfer_to_findcare, verify_token, get_secret.
entries.claude_stipulation: Chief Engineer stipulation: the acceptance is justified. v4-043's intent is to centralize cross-cutting concerns (safety, auth, audit, classify) on a single graph orchestration surface so a change to any shared concern propagates to every business entry point automatically. The 20 handlers in this exemption do not exercise those cross-cutting concerns: health/splash/serve_index produce static or reflective responses with no LLM/safety/audit involvement; transfer_to_findcare/evaluate_proxy/shared_splash are HTTP proxies whose downstream service runs its own graph; debug_verify_live/debug_bootstrap are gated debug endpoints; *_verify_token and get_secret are mTLS/Key Vault security primitives that MUST fail loud rather than route through an LLM-bearing graph (per the no-silent-security-fallbacks rule). Mechanical exemption is therefore the right disposition; the real v4-043 work is the BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-001 refactor of /classify and the EvaluateCare scoring endpoints, which remain blocking. Pairing this acceptance with BUG-ARCH-GRAPH-EXEMPT-001 (deferred) ensures each exemption is revisited during the scheduled graph refactor rather than becoming permanent by inattention.
